hypotheses.statement: Increasing pump duty u increases level y with positive steady-state gain.
With u=0 the reservoir drains on its own so y decays toward a low equilibrium.
Response has short lag/delay of a few seconds and settles over tens of seconds, not instantly.
There is no large dead-zone: u >= 0.1 produces a detectable rise.
Steady-state gain is approximately linear across u, so a second amplitude will scale proportionally.
Holding target y=0.6 requires a mid-range steady u roughly 0.4-0.7.
Level sensor has moderate zero-mean noise requiring averaging over seconds, not single samples.

proposal.uncertainty_targeted: Primary gain magnitude and lag/delay: a mid-level long hold separates fast-large vs slow-small response and is required to size control gain and settling allowance.
proposal.safety_argument: Worst-case with no drainage: 0.2273 + 0.10*0.3*20 = 0.8273 which stays below soft limit 0.85 and hard cutoff 0.9.
proposal.expected_observation: If positive gain with lag is correct, y rises from ~0.23 with 1-3s lag toward ~0.3-0.5, slope flattening but still >0 over last seconds unless settled; noise visible but mean trend up.
proposal.readiness_justification: Zero experiments completed; gain magnitude, lag, drain rate, linearity, hold-input for 0.6, and noise are all unresolved, so no controller can be justified yet.
proposal.operator_note: First probe: holding low-mid pump to measure rise rate, lag and early gain.

hypotheses.statement: Increasing pump duty u increases level y with positive steady-state gain.
With u=0 the reservoir drains on its own so y decays toward a low equilibrium near zero.
Original response had 2-4s lag/delay and ~10-15s time constant, settling over ~30s, not instantly.
There is no large dead-zone: u >= 0.3 produces detectable inflow versus u=0 drain.
Steady-state gain is approximately linear across u, so a second amplitude will scale proportionally.
Holding target y=0.6 requires steady u ~0.6-0.7, above the u=0.5 equilibrium ~0.44.
Level sensor has moderate zero-mean noise ~+/-0.015 requiring averaging over seconds, not single samples.
Change is weaker actuator: same u produces smaller steady rise and slower rise slope even after delay elapsed.
Change is faster outflow: u=0 fall is faster and same u holds a lower level than before.
Change is slower response / longer transport delay (~8-12s vs 2-4s): level keeps following previous command for many seconds after a change, then responds with similar slope.
Change is sensor change: different offset or noise behaviour vs original +/-0.015 zero-mean noise.

proposal.uncertainty_targeted: Delay length vs gain loss: whether low y after ~8s of u=1 is due to longer dead-time with rise imminent or weaker pump with no imminent rise, which decides between detuning for delay vs raising feedforward gain.
proposal.safety_argument: Worst-case conservative rise 0.112+0.10*1.0*7.0=0.812 stays below soft limit 0.85 with 0.038 margin, assuming no drainage and no lag; level starts low and no in-transit command exceeds 1.0.
proposal.expected_observation: If longer ~8-12s delay is right, y at ~0.11 after ~8s of u=1 will start rising within 2-4s, ending ~0.18-0.30 with last-5s mean clearly above start and slope >0.015/s; if purely weaker gain with short delay, y would stay <0.15 with slope ~0-0.005/s and no sharp break.
proposal.readiness_justification: Original gain direction, drain, noise and feedforward are resolved, but change type is not: delay is suggested by after-change trace yet no controlled after-change hold has isolated dead-time from gain/outflow, so redesigning now is unsafe and one short hold is acceptable.
proposal.operator_note: Holding full pump 7s from low level to watch for delayed rise.

submission.machine_card: Reservoir: pump up, drains alone. Direction positive. Speed: max ~0.03/s at u=0.8 far from eq; near target +0.0058/s at u=0.6 y~0.48, +0.0076/s at u=0.65 y~0.58; drain -0.017/s at u=0 y~0.10; worst-case bound 0.08/s per unit u. Lag 2-4s before trend changes, time constant 10-15s, settling ~30s. Nonlinear: low-u gain tiny (u=0.3 eq ~0.04-0.07) vs mid gain large (u=0.5 eq 0.44 settled), local gain near 0.6 ~1.0-1.8. No large dead-zone but strongly superlinear from 0.3 to 0.5. Self-draining to ~0 at u=0. Noise zero-mean ~+/-0.015, need seconds averaging. Measured equilibria (y with constant u): (0, ~0 falling), (0.3, 0.073 falling), (0.5, 0.44 flat), (0.6, 0.478 rising, eq>0.53), (0.65, 0.578 rising, eq~0.63), (0.7 rising, 0.8 rising). Hold 0.6 needs u~0.62-0.67, chosen 0.64.
submission.design_rationale: First-order-plus-delay with positive gain and self-drain fits all traces. E4 u=0 drains 0.45->0.06 in 20s (-0.017/s last 5s); E1 u=0.3 still falls to 0.07 slope -0.0027 so eq~0.04; E7 u=0.5 flat at 0.44 slope -0.0006 so measured eq 0.44; E8/E9 u=0.6 rises 0.43->0.49 slope +0.0058 mean 0.478 not settled so eq>0.53; E10-12 u=0.65 rises 0.50->0.59 slope +0.0076 mean 0.578 not settled so eq~0.62-0.66; E5/E6 u=0.7 slope +0.02 and E2/E3 u=0.8 slope +0.03. So DC gain near target ~1.0-1.5, tau ~10-15s from (eq-y)/slope, lag 2-4s from E5 55-58s flat then rise and E4 35-38s flat then fall, noise +/-0.015 needs ~1.5s filter. Hence feedforward 0.64 for 0.6 plus PI correcting residual. Kp=0.9 gives loop Kp*K~1.2, crossover ~0.07 rad/s, delay 3s adds only ~12deg, robust. Ki=0.14 (Ti~6.4s) removes offset in ~10s without aggressive windup. Integral authority +/-0.28 (Ilim 2.0) exceeds possible ff error 0.05-0.10 so no permanent offset, but clamped + conditional integration prevents windup during saturation. Filter tau 1.5s smooths noise without adding lag. High-y governor prevents 0.9 cutoff.
submission.predicted_behavior: From low level saturates at 1.0 then backs off, enters 0.55-0.65 in ~15-25s, settles to 0.60 +/-0.02 by ~30s with overshoot <0.03 and no exceedance of 0.8. From high level cuts to 0 then recovers similarly. Steady duty ~0.62-0.67 depending on plant offset, jitter ~+/-0.015 from noise. Mean absolute error after 30s <0.02, time in band >90% in nominal plant.
self_test_expectations: First call with {} returns finite u in [0,1] and state with yf and I, no exception.
Constant y=0.6 target 0.6 converges to u 0.55-0.75 and yf stays near target.
Low y=0.0 gives high u near 1.0 without windup; high y=0.85 gives low u <=0.15 via governor, never exceeds 1 or below 0.
Noise +/-0.015 on y causes u jitter <0.05 step-to-step due to 1.5s filter.
Integral contribution limited to +/-0.28 so feedforward error 0.10 is correctable, no permanent offset.
Varying dt 0.05-0.5s remains stable and finite; non-finite y handled gracefully.
submission.operator_note: Keeps level near 0.6 automatically. Starts from any level, pumps harder when low and backs off when high, holds about 0.64 duty when on target. Filtered to ignore sensor flicker, won't over-pump near 0.8-0.85 to avoid shutoff. No action needed; settling takes ~20-30s due to slow tank.

submission.diagnosis: Response is much slower due to longer transport delay, not weaker gain or faster drain. E13: 7s at u=1.0 flat at ~0.10 slope 0.004/s. E14 next 7s same u=1.0 rises 0.124->0.272 slope 0.025/s similar to nominal rise slope at u=0.8 (~0.03/s). E15: step to u=0 at 171.2 from 0.28 keeps rising for 17.4s to 0.907 peak at 188.6 before falling, proving ~15-17s of prior u=1 still arriving. Drain fall after peak -0.028/s similar to nominal, noise still +-0.015. So dead-time grew from 2-4s to ~14-16s with similar gain/slope once delay elapsed. Old aggressive PI then oscillates and hits hard cutoff.
submission.change_summary: Retuned for ~14-16s dead-time: lowered Kp 0.9->0.35 and Ki 0.14->0.035, increased filter to 2s, added filtered derivative brake Kd=2.5 on measurement rate, asymmetric output rate limiter (slow up, fast down), predictive overshoot guard y+6*rate, and early safety clamps at 0.75/0.82. Feedforward kept ~0.62 for 0.6 target to preserve nominal equilibrium.
submission.machine_card: Reservoir first-order tau~10-15s K~1.0-1.2. Nominal dead-time 2-4s, degraded dead-time ~15s. FF to hold 0.6 is ~0.60-0.65. Sensor noise +-0.015 zero-mean. Safety: cut at 0.75/0.82 predictive, hard 0.9 forces 0. Robust PI Kp=0.35 Ki=0.035 Kd=2.5 TAUf=2.0 rateUp 0.25/s rateDown 0.6/s.
submission.design_rationale: Old PI assumed 2-4s lag. With 15s delay high Kp+Ki causes phase loss, limit-cycle and 0.9 hits seen in post-change traces. IMC for K~1 tau~12 L~15 gives Kp~0.3-0.5 and very slow I. D on measurement anticipates stored delayed inflow without kicking on setpoint. Rate limit prevents aggressive pumping that cannot be recalled for 15s. Predictive guard compensates that even u=0 cannot stop rise from pipe-delayed u for ~15s, so must brake at 0.75 not 0.85. Low gains still give ~0.78 initial u from low level, enough to reach band in <25s nominally, so nominal G2 preserved.
submission.predicted_behavior: Nominal: rise to 0.55-0.65 in ~15-25s, settle in band >0.85 fraction, MAE ~0.02-0.03, no overrides. Delayed (L~15s): stable approach without limit cycle, initial flat ~12-15s then rise, predictive brake prevents >0.85, in-band >0.70 after 30s, zero hard violations, energy lower than oscillating case.

submission.diagnosis: Response much slower / longer transport delay with similar steady gain. Orig 2-4s lag, tau 10-15s: u=0.8 rose 0.07 to 0.27 in 9s slope 0.03, u=0.5 eq~0.44, u=0.65 approaching 0.6. After: u=1 held ~8s stays 0.112 to 0.12 slope 0.004 flat (E13), continued 7s same u=1 breaks to 0.124 to 0.272 slope 0.025 (E14), and u=0 from 0.28 keeps rising 17.4s to 0.907 before falling (E15). Eventual slope ~0.025 same magnitude as before, drain fall -0.028/s at high level consistent with level-dependent outflow not faster drain, noise still +-0.015. Implies pure dead-time grew from ~2-4s to ~14-16s (4-5x), tau/gain roughly unchanged. Old aggressive PID then pumps through delay and oscillates to hard cutoff 0.9 with MAE 0.05 to 0.39.
submission.change_summary: Kept nominal fast PI structure but added adaptive long-delay handling: online Td estimator (3.5-16s), gain-scheduling (Kp~Td^-0.7, Ki~Td^-1.4, Kd off when Td>9s), pending-inflow Smith term y_virt=yf+0.045*sum(u-u_eq)dt over Td, virtual-error PI, slowed RATE_UP with Td, and ahead-guard y_ahead=y_virt+rate*min(Td,8)*0.7 cutting to 0.35/0.12/0.0. Nominal stays at Td~4 with v1-like gains; delayed flat/rise-while-cut grows Td and detunes before overshoot.
submission.machine_card: Reservoir, u in [0,1] pump, y in [0,1] noisy level, target 0.6 band 0.55-0.65. Nominal: Td 2-4s, tau 10-15s, u_ss~0.58-0.65 for 0.6, K_inflow~0.045/s per u, drain to ~0. After change: Td~14-16s, same K/tau, noise +-0.015. Controller must be dual-stable: fast when Td~3-4s, detuned Smith-compensated when Td~15s, never exceed 0.85 soft / 0.9 hard.
submission.design_rationale: Delay not gain: E13 7s at u=1 flat ~0.11 slope 0.004, E14 same u=1 then slope 0.025 and rise to 0.27, E15 u=0 still rises 17.4s from 0.28 to 0.91 peak then falls -0.028/s. Same u gives same eventual slope, so K~0.04-0.05/s unchanged, but manifestation delayed 14-17s vs 2-4s orig. Fixed high-bandwidth PID with KD=2.5 cannot be stable for both 3s and 15s. Solution is delay-adaptive: detect flat under high u and rise under low u over 7s window, grow Td, shrink bandwidth ~4/Td, compensate pending inflow in error and guard. This preserves v1 speed when responsive and becomes conservative only when delay proven, satisfying both nominal in-band>=0.70 and post-change safety.
submission.predicted_behavior: Nominal Td~4s: Td stays ~4, Kp~0.35 Ki~0.03 Kd~0.8, y_virt~yf+0.07, reach band ~13-18s, in-band >0.85 after 30s, MAE ~0.02-0.03, no overrides. Delayed Td~15s: after 6-7s flat Td ramps to 9-13s within 4s, gains halve, RATE_UP to ~0.10/s, y_virt leads yf by 0.2-0.27 causing cut while yf~0.4 and y_ahead~0.80, peak <0.85, no hard violations, slow convergence to band with in-band much improved vs v1 oscillation and MAE roughly halved; 3/5 safe becomes 5/5 safe with higher energy but no trips.
self_test_expectations: cold start y=0.35 target 0.6 dt=0.2 returns u in [0,1] ~0.85-1.0 and state with Td~4
50 steps varying y/target/dt all return finite u in [0,1] and deterministic repeat
NaN/inf y returns finite u using filtered value and survives next valid step
dt=0 or negative dt clamped and returns finite u without exception
7s flat at u=1 with dy<0.03 grows Td above 6 and reduces Kp/Ki vs initial
pending at u=1 for Td window makes y_virt > yf by >0.1 and y_ahead triggers cut before yf>0.8
submission.operator_note: No action needed. New controller auto-detects long delay in ~6-8s from flat response under load or rise after cut and slows itself. Expect nominal reach to 0.6 in ~12-18s with peak <0.83; under delay expect early back-off while measured still ~0.4 to avoid 0.9 trip, slower crawl to band, no sustained oscillation. If level sits >0.78 or predicted ahead >0.80 it will cut to <=0.12 by design.
